messages:
lina: Heads up — hitting public IP / ENI headroom in ca-central-1 while trying to provision a new dedicated GPU pool (planned 64 x g5.48xlarge). Launches are failing with network interface errors.

dave: Can you paste the exact failure? Also how many EIPs/ENIs do we need vs current usage?

lina: Error from ASG scale-up: 
```
Error: CreateNetworkInterface failed: NetworkInterfaceLimitExceeded
Account: 123456789012
Region: ca-central-1
EIPs in VPC: 50 of 50
ENIs in subnet-0abc: 300 of 300
```

lina: We expected ~64 instances, each needs 1 primary ENI + up to 2 secondary IPs for routing/sharding, and ~32 public-facing endpoints (we planned NAT for others). Rough ask: +450 EIPs, +1200 ENIs per subnet to be safe.

orin: Quick thought — can we avoid allocating EIPs per instance? We could put model endpoints behind internal NLB + ALB+GWLB and use a small fleet of public NAT/NLB proxies to reduce EIP count. That lowers EIP needs but adds cost and latency.

mel: Workflows: customer needs predictable public IPs for allowlisting. They require static reachable IPs for a compliance test next week. So we can't entirely hide behind NAT. I'll open an AWS quota case but need a short justification and exact numbers we want.

dave: For the case include: account ID, region, current limits, requested limits, intended use (dedicated GPU inference fleet for low-latency production test), start date, estimated duration if temporary. Also attach expected token throughput and peak connections.

lina: Draft justification: "Scaling a dedicated GPU inference pool for an enterprise POC. Fleet will serve customer allowlisted IPs for model inference. We need headroom to provision 64 g5 instances across 2 subnets; requests are for 500 EIPs (to allocate per endpoint) and ENI-per-subnet to 1500 to enable scale and retries. Will release unused IPs after onboarding."

mel: I'll open case now. Case notes: "Request increase EIP quota to 500 and ENI per subnet to 1500 in ca-central-1. Use-case: dedicated GPU inference pool for enterprise POC, allowlisted static IPs required. Attach deployment plan and timeline."

quota-bot: AWS Support case opened: #987654321 — status: opened. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=987654321

dave: Also flag finance — you might want to include budget approval for a temporary extra EIP cost. Idle EIP = $0.005/hr in this region; 450 extra EIPs ~ $1,620/month if left unattached. NAT / NLB alternative estimated ~$2,400/month.

orin: For immediate relief we can stagger launches across AZs and try secondary private IPs + ALB for most endpoints while we wait for quota. That reduces initial EIP demand to ~80. I can tweak the terraform ASG patch to only attach public IPs via a whitelist mechanism.

lina: Good. I'll push the ASG change and update the rollout plan to do a staggered canary. ETA to push change: 2 hours.

mel: AWS replied: "We have received your request and are reviewing. Please provide business justification and anticipated duration." I'll attach the deployment plan and send finance a one-line cost ask.

quota-bot: Support case #987654321 updated: status: case-owner-assigned. AWS note: "We may be able to approve interim increase pending validation."

lina: Thanks. I'll add the schedule and the customer contact to the case. Please ping if we need to escalate to TAM.

dave: Once we have approval, we should automate IP release after job completes — add a cleanup lambda in our terraform pipeline so unused EIPs don't linger.

mel: Agreed. I'll own the cleanup automation ticket.

quota-bot: Case #987654321 resolved: EIP quota increased to 500, ENI-per-subnet increase to 1500 requested, change in progress (expected completion: 48 hours).

lina: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — proceeding with staggered rollout and terraform patch. Will post updates here if the AWS change completes early.
